prior_report_citation.value: Patient 2: Crutchfield et al. 2008; Gibson et al. 1988 (molecular confirmation: Akaboshi et al. 2003; Gibson et al. 1988)

treatment_summary.value: Carbamazepine started for focal seizures, with significant seizure reduction

clinical_diagnosis_basis.value: Urine organic acid analysis by gas chromatography-mass spectrometry showed GHB, threo- and erythro-4,5-dihydroxyhexanoic acid (DHHA) and the DHHA lactones; sequencing of genomic DNA showed a homozygous missense mutation (c.667T>C; p.Cys223Arg) in exon 4, homozygosity confirmed by parental sequencing and SNP rs2744583

age_at_last_evaluation_original_text.value: after a 20-year follow-up (first reported at 9 years of age)

clinical_diagnosis_basis.value: Urine organic acid analysis confirmed the presence of GHB; enzymatic and molecular confirmation of the diagnosis was previously achieved in white cells (Akaboshi et al. 2003; Gibson et al. 1988)

parental_testing_statement.value: The homozygous state for the missense mutation was confirmed by sequencing genomic DNA from his parents, who were T/C heterozygotes at position c.667. In addition, both parents turned out to be G/A heterozygotes for SNP rs2744583, providing further evidence that they carried two copies of the SSADH gene not deleted in exon 4.

pathogenicity_as_stated_by_authors.value: novel missense mutation; 'strongly supporting the pathogenic role of this novel nucleotide alteration' (same amino acid as c.668G>A, reported with dramatic reduction of enzyme activity, Akaboshi et al. 2003)

parental_testing_statement.value: both parents turned out to be G/A heterozygotes for SNP rs2744583; the proband inherited two copies of the rs2744583(A) allele, thus confirming the homozygous state at exon 4
